audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Urgot all seven rows while whys[0] says level 1 is even and whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say full-tank Maokai outscales him. The packet reads Skill / Urgot x5 / Maokai.
audit.why: Maokai's saplings and the first W root make level 1 a wash, and past two items his CC-and-tank package beats side-lane pressure. The page's own closing paragraph tells you to end before that point while the chart says you win it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill (5/10) and 2+ items -> Maokai (3/10) as matched full+content pairs, with phases[6].why rewritten around the 90s rank-3 ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on 'trade when his W is down' and never once says how long that is.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 falling to 10s — a short enough window that 'punish the cooldown' means about ten seconds of work, not a lane-defining hole. Sapling Toss is 18s from 1100 range and Nature's Grasp 130s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The 14s figure written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, early, mid and spikes[2]; the 1100 sapling range into dontsFull[1].d; the 90s rank-3 R into phases[6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) spikes[0] says 'tank the root, Purge him during it' — Maokai is UNTARGETABLE for the duration of the Twisted Advance dash, so damage poured into that window is thrown away. (b) 'Q execute' / 'Q outer-ring' appears again in three fields; Corrosive Charge has no execute in Riot's text. (c) mid says 'your R executes him regardless of his HP' — it is a health threshold. (d) The sustain is attributed to 'passive saplings and W healing'; the healing is Sap Magic (P) off his autos, and its cooldown shortens every time he casts a spell or is hit by one. (e) breakdown.cooldowns contradicts itself, saying 'Dodge it' and 'lock-on, undodgeable' in the same field.
audit.why: (a) and (c) are the expensive ones — one wastes your Purge channel, the other wastes a 100-second ultimate on a full-health tank. (d) matters for itemization: Grievous Wounds answers an auto-attack heal that gets faster the more spells fly, which is exactly what a long Urgot trade produces.
audit.corrected: Untargetability stated and the instruction changed to start Purge as he LANDS; Q named as Corrosive Charge; R restated as a threshold execute; Sap Magic named as the heal with its cooldown-reduction rule; the cooldown field made internally consistent.

notes: The costly correction here is Twisted Advance's untargetability: the page told the player to 'Purge him during it', which throws the channel into a window where he cannot be damaged at all. The 'Q execute / outer-ring' fabrication has now appeared in three of my matchups (ksante, malphite, maokai) with near-identical wording — it is a champion-level template error on urgot and deserves a grep across every urgot matchup, not just these three. Same for 'R executes him regardless of his HP', which appeared here and on ksante.
